detail.longDescription:
Hermes Conduit is an independent client for your own Hermes agent, on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Your sessions, profiles, bots and tools are the same ones you use on desktop, in a touch-first app built for chatting, talking, and keeping an eye on your agent while you're away from your desk.

TALK TO HERMES

• Real-time voice calls with Gemini Live, GPT-Live and Grok Live, or Local Live on your own speech server: natural conversation with echo cancellation and interruption, not speak, wait, reply
• Start, check and cancel Hermes jobs by voice, with results folded back into the call
• Calls stay with the chat you started them from, keep going with the screen locked, and shrink to a bar while you read
• Hermes can call you: ask it to ring when a job is done and answer like a normal phone call, even from your Watch
• Talk from Apple Watch on its own, from CarPlay, from Siri, or with a wake phrase
• Classic voice and dictation with spoken Stop and End, plus Read Aloud for any reply

CHAT WITHOUT LOSING CONTEXT

• Pick up desktop sessions and project chats where you left them, with replies streaming in live
• Markdown, highlighted code, math, Mermaid diagrams and task lists
• Map, place, travel and info cards that Hermes draws right in the chat
• Follow thinking, tool calls and each turn's steps, or keep them folded away
• Attach photos, camera shots and any file; quote text, react to messages
• Browse every file and artifact Hermes made, across all chats or in one
• Saved chats open instantly and you can type while Conduit reconnects

TASKS, BOTS AND GROUPS

• Tasks board: follow Hermes' Kanban tasks and add new ones
• Open your Hermes bots and their Bot Chats; add them to group chats and mention anyone with @
• Review, run and manage scheduled jobs

YOUR PHONE, IF YOU ALLOW IT

Every one is off until you turn it on, and goes only to your own Hermes host:
• Location and place rules, travel times and directions
• Calendar and reminders, with each change asked first
• Apple Health data
• Alarms and timers, and contacts you pick
• Ask Hermes about what's on your screen, or send anything to it from Shortcuts

STAY IN CONTROL

• Approve tools and answer questions straight from a notification, end-to-end encrypted between your host and your phone
• Live Activities show a running reply on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Home Screen widgets to start a chat or talk in one tap
• Switch providers, models and reasoning effort mid-conversation; watch context use; steer or stop a turn
• Branch, pin, archive and delete sessions; switch profiles and Hermes servers
• Turn skills, tools, connectors and plugins on or off, and read gateway logs
• Face ID or Touch ID lock, credentials kept in the Keychain

EASY TO SET UP

Sign in with your dashboard address, a QR code or a setup link from your agent. Install the free Hermes Conduit Notifier plugin on your host for notifications, voice calls, cards and phone features.

BUILT FOR SELF-HOSTED HERMES

Conduit connects to the Hermes dashboard you run, and in live voice calls to the voice provider you choose. It is not a hosted AI service, and a working Hermes installation is required. Free, no ads, no analytics.

Available in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish and Turkish.

Hermes Conduit is an independent client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nous Research.
